notes.title: Patch 0.8 released. Zeal is back on Steam!
notes.notes:
Zeal hasn't been available on Steam for about a year, and you might be wondering, what was going on?

We were running private playtesting through Discord, and if you've missed them, here are the latest changes: 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33188525/2b11a9189c4e5409a08341b8da82ca75afccba8f.png[/img]

— Zeal is now a tab targeted game with controls and combat similar to WoW.
— Mastery/Prime customization system replaced with Talent Trees

Play Zeal for Free on Steam! 
Currently 6 classes are available, 2 more coming soon, and another 2 later this year.

notes.title: Patch Notes 0.4.13
notes.notes:
[h1]General[/h1]
— Casters and Ranger now have 13000 Health.
— All casts that were 1.1 or 1.2 seconds are now 1.0 second.
— GCD reduced from 0.75 to 0.70 seconds.

[h1]Conquest[/h1]
— Conquest is now played as 10 teams of 2.
— Conquest is now always available and starts automatically after maximum 10 minutes of waiting. Empty slots are filled with bots.
— If you queue solo, you’ll get a bot who will follow and assist you
— Bot teammates will pick up items only if they think you don’t need them. To force them to get an item, loot it and drop back to the ground.
— Experience is now shared to all team members within 50 meters.
— All NPCs now have more health and deal more damage.
— Poisonous Spider’s poison now can be dispelled (as Poison).
— Call Help now pulls up to 2 NPCs of the same type (was unlimited).
— Last Stand now can be broken by defense breaking abilities.
— Enrage is now instant and has a visual effect.

[h1]Known issues[/h1]
— The conquest map is being reworked and is not finished yet. Some areas might look weird or empty. Also, NPCs are still placed randomly.

[h1]Bugs[/h1]
— Points previously put into Swiftness are now available again.
— Secondary resource is now correctly consumed when a cast is finished.
— Wizard’s Energy Lash now correctly hits to the direction of the camera, not the direction of the character.
— Now you can’t jump on small NPCs like crabs or spiders.

[h1]Cleric[/h1]
— Divine Prayer removed.
— Light Spike now restores 20 Mana.

Since this system alone already provides pretty deep customization, we’re reverting the number of baselines to 4 and reducing the mastery and prime limits by 1.
Note that’s a development build and the work is still in progress, some spells are placeholders, others might be too strong or too weak, and, generally, the system is not final.

notes.title: March Update
notes.notes:
Unfortunate outcome of our Kickstarter campaign has hindered our capability of working on Zeal, the development has been considerably slower in comparison to our previous pace. While allocating our extremely limited resources and time for the campaign greatly slowed our progress during the last months, we will never stop our efforts towards making this game the most fun no-grind RPG around. 

We’re currently working on new content such as a brand new talent system, weapon system, in-game arena tournaments, new modes and new classes.
We’re planning to launch a Patreon page where you can support the game every month in order to help us quicken the development and allow us to replace placeholders. Patreon page will be launched later this month (perhaps in April) as supporters will get early access to new content and many other rewards which will be announced later.

Meanwhile, the current arena season will end in 4 weeks, on April 4th.

https://zealrpg.com/ladder/2v2
Our ladder has been updated and now includes the final requirements for the rewards.
3v3 temporarily won’t be available due to low population. 
A total of 100 wins are required for titles.

Also, small update for the 0.4 patch will be released today.
